part1.intro: The examiner asks the candidate about him/herself, his/her home, work or studies and other familiar topics.

topics.title: Musical instruments
questions: Which instrument do you like listening to most? [Why?]
Have you ever learned to play a musical instrument? [Which one?]
Do you think children should learn to play a musical instrument at school? [Why/Why not?]
How easy would it be to learn to play an instrument without a teacher? [Why?]

part2.topic: Describe something healthy you enjoy doing.
part2.closing: and explain why you think doing this is healthy.

topics.title: Keeping fit and healthy
questions: What do most people do to keep fit in your country?
How important is it for people to do some regular physical exercise?

topics.title: Health and modern lifestyles
questions: Why do some people think that modern lifestyles are not healthy?
Why do some people choose to lead unhealthy lives?
Should individuals or governments be responsible for making people's lifestyle healthy?
What could be done to encourage people to live in a healthy way?
